CustomField.description: How a sleeve of this classification may be funded, enforced by the Order Ticket wizard: Dollar Only sleeves are fixed carve-outs, Percent Only sleeves are actively traded model weights, and Either lets the advisor choose per submission. The wizard filters each list's strategy picker by this value, so a Dollar Only strategy is never offered as a percentage sleeve. IGNORED where Excluded From Allocation is checked: an exception sleeve carries no target weight, so it is always recorded in dollars whatever this field says. See TradeInstructionController.effectiveAllowedBasisFor (mirror) and c/envelopeFormSchema STRATEGY_BASIS.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Dollar Only = fixed carve-out. Percent Only = traded model weight. Either = the advisor chooses.
CustomField.label: Allowed Funding Basis
